description: Both convenience formatters emit ChatML rather than the inspected Ernie instruction templates.
trigger: Call default_chat_prompt for ERNIE-4.5-0.3B-PT or ERNIE-4.5-21B-A3B-PT.
expected_behavior: Match the checkpoint template's begin-of-sentence marker, User:/Assistant: labels and assistant generation prefix.
actual_behavior: The new methods emit im_start/im_end blocks. Whole-parent search found only a direct caller in the vision-only imgsearch example, not evidence that normal text generation calls this helper. The inherited Dots formatter mismatch is therefore carried into new methods, with Ernie-specific expected formatting.

verification.description: Compared both added formatters with pinned tokenizer templates and inspected the located direct caller.
verification.limits: No generation test; external caller reach is unknown.

introductions.rationale: New Ernie classes supply a ChatML default helper while the pinned reference tokenizers use begin_of_sentence and User/Assistant labels. Direct helper reach only; no inference failure demonstrated.
